notablePrerequisites:
Necrosynthesis attached to Herd Baloth.
You control another creature to sacrifice.
description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a creature, adding one mana of any color.
Necrosynthesis triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a 4/4 Beast creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Beast token, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat from step 2.
